# Table.FuzzyNestedJoin

```m
Table.FuzzyNestedJoin(table1 as table, key1 as any, table2 as table, key2 as any, newColumnName as text, optional joinKind as nullable number, optional joinOptions as nullable record) as table
```

Performs a fuzzy join between tables on supplied columns and produces the join result in a new column.

*Description: Microsoft, MIT ([THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](../../../../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)).*

Reference: [Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/powerquery-m/table-fuzzynestedjoin)

| Name | Type | Optional |
|---|---|---|
| `table1` | `table` | no |
| `key1` | `any` | no |
| `table2` | `table` | no |
| `key2` | `any` | no |
| `newColumnName` | `text` | no |

| `joinOptions` | `nullable record` | yes |
